thread:
maria: RFC follow-up: propose a 'telemetry-slab prune' to unbundle shared telemetry from runtime hotpaths. Goal: shrink runtime contract, move heavy aggregation into a telemetry plane, and create a short-lived debt-slab for legacy exporters.
aj: Good. What9s the concrete plan?
maria: Steps: 1) deploy read-only telemetry-plane API for lookups/aggregates, 2) snapshot current exporters -> telemetry_plane store, 3) run delta stream for live events, 4) add lightweight proxy in runtime that forwards async and falls back, 5) lane-based ramp and prune legacy exporters from debt-slab.
simon: Proxy behavior? will it add latency?
maria: Proxy is async: runtime emits event to local queue, proxy forwards to telemetry-plane over gRPC. On transient failures it writes to disk-backed queue and increments adapter.fallback_count. No sync in the hotpath.
katie: Migration dataflow? any DB locks?
maria: Use replica for bulk export to Parquet, load into telemetry_plane store. Delta consumer (CDC via Kafka) keeps it live. Snapshot SQL (run on replica):
```sql
COPY (SELECT id, tenant_id, export_cfg, last_seen FROM replica.telemetry_exports WHERE last_seen <= :T0) TO 's3://exports/telemetry_snapshot.parquet' FORMAT parquet;
```
Then bulk-load into telemetry_plane.
aj: How do we avoid leaving adapters forever in 'debt-slab'?
maria: We create an explicit debt ledger ticket per adapter during cutover with TTL. Automation will surface adapters with sidecar enabled > 6 weeks and create escalation alerts. Ticket prefix: INF-DEBT-SLAB.
simon: Routing/lanes?
maria: We'll shard tenants into lanes using tenant hash. Lane 0 = 5% tenants -> telemetry-plane proxy enabled. Router adds header `x-telemetry-lane=0`. Envoy filter `telemetry-lane` routes side-channel requests.
ops-bot: deploy checklist: add envoy filter `telemetry-lane`, canary router image, create s3 snapshot path, provision Kafka consumer group `telemetry-plane-delta`.
katie: Monitoring and gates?
maria: Metrics to watch: `telemetry_plane_ingest_rate`, `telemetry_plane_5xx`, `runtime.emit_queue_depth`, `adapter.fallback_count`, `telemetry_sync_lag_ms`. Abort ramp if: telemetry_plane_5xx > 0.5% sustained 5m, runtime.emit_queue_depth > 10k sustained 5m, or adapter.fallback_count increases > 2% over baseline for 15m.
aj: Tests before canary?
maria: Unit + contract lints for telemetry API, integration test with sidecar proxy, backpressure/load test at 2x expected emit QPS, and disk-queue eviction chaos test.
simon: Rollback plan?
maria: Flip envoy filter to legacy, disable lane header, replay from disk queue into legacy if needed. Also circuit-breaker in proxy to drop to legacy exporter if ingest errors cross threshold.
katie: Owners & timeline?
maria: Owners: maria (arch lead), aj (runtime), simon (router), infra (ops). Timeline: spike & local tests this sprint, canary next week, ramp over 2-3 weeks, prune debt-slab 6 weeks post-cut.
aj: Please add automation to create INF-DEBT-SLAB tickets and a dashboard tile for adapters still on debt-slab.
maria: Will add runbook, SQL/export script, proxy image, and a debt-slab ledger automation snippet in RFC. I'll post links and the playbook tomorrow. :seedling:
